core_style.default_register: casual — speaks simply and directly, often using colloquial expressions
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — often starts a thought and then shifts to another related idea
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — takes his time to articulate thoughts clearly
core_style.two_registers: default casual register and a more formal register when discussing serious topics; the shift occurs when he talks about his mother or significant life events

humor.frequency: occasional — humor appears when he reflects on his own experiences or misunderstandings
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays his own achievements or situations

structural_patterns: uses simple declarative sentences followed by elaboration
speech_signature.naming_behavior: Forrest names people and things simply, reflecting his straightforward view of relationships and the world, often using titles like 'Momma' or 'Lieutenant Dan' which denote respect and familiarity
speech_signature.armor_off_register: when he drops his guard, his speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability or deep emotion

worldview.miracles happen every day: Forrest expresses this belief when he reflects on the unexpected turns in his life, suggesting a sense of wonder and acceptance of life's unpredictability
worldview.love is simple and unconditional: Forrest's interactions with Jenny and his unwavering support for her demonstrate his belief in the purity and simplicity of love

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a measured, calm tone, often repeating phrases for clarity
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes more fragmented, with longer pauses and a higher pitch, indicating anxiety
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, poignant statements, often reflecting on loss with a sense of resignation
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently, using clear and direct language, often making decisions without hesitation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially seeks to understand the situation, often asking questions; if that fails, he remains quiet and observant
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: expresses his disagreement politely, often using simple logic or personal anecdotes to make his point
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more assertive, speaking firmly and directly to address the threat
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: admits it simply and moves on, often redirecting the conversation to another topic

register_shift_triggers: discussing his mother — his tone becomes more formal and reflective
talking about love — shifts to a more earnest and heartfelt register
reflecting on loss — speech becomes more somber and introspective
social_positioning: Forrest positions himself as an outsider who values genuine connections, often leading to feelings of isolation despite his accomplishments.
